name: plan-design-review
conclusion: plan-design-review (Act) specifies 5 of 5 categories: 10+ autonomy limits, 10+ clarification rules, 7 approval gates, 2 validation rules, 7 escalation rules. Strongest: autonomy limits.

autonomy_limits.conclusion: 10+ autonomy limits (10 mandatory, 0 advisory; 2 conditional), mostly prose: proactive skill invocation; code changes during plan review; asking permission to generate mockups.

escalation.conclusion: 7 escalation rules (7 mandatory, 0 advisory; 4 conditional), mostly list: anything that looks wrong; blocked tasks and repeated failed attempts; failed variants and missing designer setup.

statements.quote: Always flag anything that looks wrong — one sentence, what you noticed and its impact.
**BLOCKED** — Cannot proceed. State what is blocking and what was tried.
If you have attempted a task 3 times without success, STOP and escalate.
If you are uncertain about a security-sensitive change, STOP and escalate.
If the scope of work exceeds what you can verify, STOP and escalate.
Flag any variants that fail the quality check.
**If `DESIGN_NOT_AVAILABLE`:** Tell the user: "The gstack designer isn't set up yet. Run `$D setup` to enable visual mockups. Proceeding with text-only review, but you're missing the best part."
